newsitem.title: POLAND: Budimex signs PLN 240 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Budimex signs PLN 240 mln contract.

text.p: Polish construction company Budimex SA signed a 240-million-zloty contract on Monday to build part of the sewage treatment plant in the northern city of Gdansk within the next three years.

"At today's prices, the construction work will be worth 188 million zlotys while the remaining sum includes costs of the plant's equipment and costs of using construction equipment," Budimex's financial director Marek Michalowski told Reuters.
Gdansk President Tomasz Posadzki said after the signing ceremony that the new plant would allow treatment of all sewage coming from the city. Currently, only 70 percent of Gdansk sewage is treated.
Budimex won a tender to build the sewage plant last month.
